full_judgment: 9. The appellant's papers concerning the pattan and the original kabala were not before the court. The appellant was not examined and there was no explanation as to why she could not be examined. Her husband DW 3 Satya Ranjan Guha said in cross examination that the attesting witnesses of the pattan migrated to India and none of them was available. Papers of Umesh were also missing. As the pattani papers were looted away the pattani land was kabala purchased by his wife. The kabala i.e. Ext A II was executed and registered at Dhaka and the appellant's husband acted as the identifier. Umesh, a police constable posted at Manikganj, could have been examined for proving the execution of the kabala, but he was not examined. The deed-writer and the attesting witnesses were also not examined. The plaintiffs suggested that the kabala was executed by false personification and it was a fake and collusive document for which no consideration was paid.
